title: Hamilton Beach 2-Way 12 Cup Programmable Drip Hot and Iced Coffee Maker & Single Serve Coffee Machine, AquaFlow Showerhead, Glass Carafe, Auto Pause and Pour, Black (47500J)
reviews: This coffee pot is the best one I've had in a long time. You can brew any size pot you want or just one cup up to 14 oz. Put in water, put in grounds and turn it on...super simple. It doesn't do pods, but that's ok by me because they are too expensive for me anyway. The pot is programmable to have coffee ready when you wake up. It has a sensor so that if you need a cup before the pot is done brewing you can remove the pot to poor a cup and it stops and doesn't drip on the warming plate. I have not had to clean up coffee that ended up somewhere other than the pot or the cup and best part, no grounds in the pot or the cup. I am a happy customer. It was 69.99 which I think is a great value for the price compared to other coffee makers. I highly recommend.

I love this coffee maker. It allows me to make one cup or a full pot. The coffee tastes very good. You can also make iced coffee but I don't care about that because I don't make iced coffee. Price was reasonable. It's simple looking. You can Brew bold coffee. I love everything about it.

Love love love. Works great, easy to clean, great brew options. Just be aware, the single brew side has it's own reusable filter but the carafe side doesn't. Need to buy one separately or use the paper ones.

I am pleased with this purchase for the price. I love the single serve option and being able to do cold brew. It is simple to use and the pot heats the wat up really well so you get a nice brew. My only complaint is that I end up dripping coffee every time I pour. The pot is just poorly designed for pouring. I just pour over the sink to avoid the issue.
Works great. Coffee is delicious. Slowly pours water through. Perfect

This is a good coffee pot however I only purchased this one was because it had the cold brew option but the cold brew option is just as hot as the regular brew so it wasn’t worth the purchase. Wish I would’ve gone with my other choice because that one had the feature for it to stop brewing into the pot when you removed it to pour a cup so you don’t have to wait until the entire pot is finished like you do with this one. Coffee just keeps pouring out if I remove the pot to fill my cup.

After having my Keurig break down after only 22 months I decided to go back to grounds. I am loving my new Hamilton coffee maker. It was super easy to set up and it’s compact. I don’t have a lot of counter space so it’s nice that it does not take up very much space. The coffee brews hot and you can adjust the cup height for single brew. I especially love the price I paid and I got the 3 year extended warranty. It was still a lot cheaper than a new Keurig. The coffee tastes great 👍🏼 My only negative comment is that I have to fill the water tanks each time. They recommended not leaving water in the tanks. But I’ll get used to it. I also got myself a coffee grinder to get back to whole beans. My coffee is tasting better already and it’s healthier for you than k-cups!

I got this one to replace my single serve Keurig. I wanted all three options that this one provides. The timer is so nice so that I have coffee when I wake up in the coffee pot. It stays warm for a couple of hours and then turns off. This makes me feel good about not burning the house down with my forgetfulness. You can brew 12 cups! The single serve side causes some splashing and I’m not sure why but I just wipe off the maker anyway. It’s made well. It comes with a reusable mesh pod like thing to make single serves. I ordered a mesh basket that fits in this for the pot side also. I like them better than paper filters or plastic. The coffee isn’t brewed aa fast as a Keurig. On either side but that’s ok because it’s delicious and it works. The only thing I dislike is that the pot isn’t the easiest to wash. It’s very easy to use and set the timers and click too. I do recommend this coffee pot. Ita nice.
